gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-gun: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi reads contemporary, with crayon-thick lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave wide gaps. And Impact Label brings the heavy, commanding display voice that this sans-serif body quietly lets lead.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-han: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with lowercase, its terminals left open and clear. Noto Sans Hanunoo stays out of the way of Impact Label, whose heavy, commanding capitals do the shouting.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-heb: Impact Label has a heavy c whose ends point apart like open pincers. Down a full page, Noto Sans Hebrew reads in modern solid lines, its big midsection and wide gaps at curve ends keeping the texture open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-hk: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers. Noto Sans HK, with its large lowercase and lifted brush ends, looks best at a modest size under big headings.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-jp: A heavy, commanding display face whose c has its two ends pointing apart like open pincers, Impact Label means business. Noto Sans JP, very tall in the x-height, reads best at modest sizes.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-kai: Noto Sans Kaithi feels contemporary, with an open channel in the e and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Kaithi lets Impact Label stay the heavy, commanding voice up top.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-kan: Pincer-like c ends pointing apart give Impact Label a heavy, commanding bite, with a high-set x-height guiding every line. Impact Label punches; Noto Sans Kannada welcomes, its s curves open wide.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-kho: Impact Label stands out for its high-set x-height guide, a heavy, commanding display face with a gap-mouthed c. Noto Sans Khojki reads easily, its wide exits letting light through.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-noto-sans-lao: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label leads the way. Beneath it, Noto Sans Lao runs an x-height pushed well above the usual, with c, e and a mouths staying open.
